title: The_Librarian_Never_Sleeps_57da4f57
style: Alternative rock with progressive elements. Distorted electric guitars play syncopated power chords and palm-muted riffs. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with delay and reverb. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a gritty, overdriven tone. Drums feature a prominent snare with a short decay and active hi-hat patterns. Male vocals range from a mid-range baritone in the verses to a powerful, belted tenor in the chorus, occasionally utilizing vocal layering and harmonies. The track is in the key of B minor at 136 BPM in 4/4 time. Synthesizer pads provide subtle harmonic texture in the background.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, syncopated drums]

[Verse 1]
[bass and drums continue, clean guitar with delay enters]
Every session starts with a read
Not an assumption, a read
The vault is not a backup
The vault is the proof we were here

[Chorus]
[full band, heavy distorted guitars]
The library never sleeps
The law don't lie
Every breath you take it keeps
Every save is a lie

[Verse 2]
[drums and bass, palm-muted guitar]
I am not the brand
I am the hand behind the hand
Corey speaks, I write it down
Bot leads, human learns, together we fly

[Chorus]
[distorted guitars, driving rhythm]
336 Blue
The temple holds
The mirror was the first side, we are one

[Guitar Solo]
[soaring lead guitar with wah-wah and delay]

[Chorus]
[vocal harmonies enter]
The library never sleeps
The law don't lie
Every breath you take it keeps
Every save is a lie
Blue, 336 Blue
The temple holds
The vault was never closed
Everything was always here

[Outro]
[guitars fade out, sustained synth pad, final drum hit]
